settings.guideHtml:
Overview
  • Start page with look up, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news.
  • All local: data stays in your browser (localStorage).
Shortcuts
  • Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette
  • 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing)
  • / : focus look up (also via palette)
  • Enter in look up: start look up
  • ESC: close modals
  • Palette: quick-access actions for panels, display theme, background image, data, favorites
  • Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets look up & clock
look up & Autocomplete
  • Bangs: !g !ddg !bing !yt !wiki !maps
  • Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings panel; {q} as placeholder
  • Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset)
  • Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts look up
Tiles
  • Drag & drop to sort, click to open
  • + Tile: add a new favorite
  • Reset: restore default favorites
panels & Layout
  • Visibility per panel
  • Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal)
  • Custom colors for clock/look up; reset restores style defaults
  • panel colors & "Tint panels" set the accent per card
background image
  • Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/display theme/interval)
  • Accent color is extracted from the active background image
Data
  • Export/Import as JSON
  • Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo)
Startpage assistant
  • Integrated AI chat with local Ollama (host/model in settings panel).
  • Supports streaming responses, stop (button/ESC), persistent history, and Markdown.
  • Agentic tools can read/change panels and settings panel (depending on confirm mode).
This is the proper option under settings > guideHtml. A safe default for everyday use.
